properties.displayName: AI Hub: Key Vault access denied
properties.description: Fires when any Key Vault operation on poc-aihub-kv-01 returns HTTP 403. Indicates a misconfigured caller, a missing role assignment, or a probing attempt.

allOf.query: AzureDiagnostics | where SubscriptionId == '${SUBSCRIPTION_ID}' | where ResourceProvider == 'MICROSOFT.KEYVAULT' | where ResourceType == 'VAULTS' | where httpStatusCode_d == 403 | summarize Count = count()
